purpose: Help a manufacturing AI team decide whether a weekly technical update contains enough evidence for coordination and risk review.
minimum_evidence: a Jira, PR, commit, or dashboard reference
an owned next action with a review date
unknown_behavior: If a claim has no verifiable reference, return unknown and ask for a safe reference. Never infer success from tone.
privacy_boundary: Do not collect hours, attendance, emotion, customer identifiers, or credentials. Redact reports and delete raw answers according to the team retention policy.
action_boundary: The tool may draft a comment or follow-up question. Any Jira mutation requires human approval and a read-back receipt.
